earnings-tracker v1.1.0

- Updated dependencies in package.json.
- Made modifications to scripts/earnings_scanner.py.
- No visible changes in user-facing documentation (SKILL.md unchanged).
- Internal improvements or fixes; no new features documented.

Earnings Tracker v1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Automatically scans A股 (AKShare) and US stocks (Yahoo Finance) earnings calendars.
- Tracks earnings previews, quick reports, and full financial results for watched companies.
- Smart highlights: beats/misses, key metrics, and AI-driven insights.
- Sends updates and reminders via Discord and Telegram.
- Weekly and real-time scheduled scans with customizable watchlists.
